[[File:Exonium.png|thumb|right|250px|Exonium]]
'''Exonium''' was a fossil fuel that could be used to produce energy. The planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] was rich in deposits of this mineral. The native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]] used the mineral in food preparation. More developed cultures used the mineral as power sources for things such as [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]]. Exonium could be refined in a way that made it a suitable fuel for use in starships.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] used Rishi as a base, taking advantage of the exonium deposits to provide them with a fuel source that did not rely on the normal galactic economy. Exonium was produced on the neutral [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Mek-Sha]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] invaded Rishi in order to obtain control over the exonium mining there. [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] lead a [[Green Company/Legends|group]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] into a battle to regain control of the mines.
